title: Clinical Outcomes With Ceftolozane-tazobactam for MDR Pseudomonas Infections
brief_summary: This study will describe clinical outcomes in patients who received ceftolozane-tazobactam for a Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection. Primary outcomes include 30-day and in-hospital mortality.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Greater than 18 years old
* Cultures positive Pseudomonas aeruginosa from any source
* Received ceftolozane-tazobactam for at least 24 hrs

Exclusion Criteria:

* Protected populations
* Prisoners, pregnant women, children
study_population: Patients who had Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection and received ceftolozane-tazobactam for at least 24 hrs for treatment.
